<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_EmployeeDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeeDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeeds" name="Development need or career aspiration identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePlan" name="Create personal development plan (training, mentorship, additional responsibilities)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoopMerge" name="Development cycle entry"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevSplit" name="Start development activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SkillEnhancement" name="Continue skill enhancement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive feedback and evaluation from supervisors"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevJoin" name="Development activities completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached?" default="Flow_MilestonesNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_HRReview" name="Conduct formal performance review"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" name="Promotion approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitions into new role"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeeds" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreatePlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreatePlan" targetRef="Gateway_LoopMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesNotReached" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Gateway_LoopMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_LoopMerge" targetRef="Gateway_DevSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_DevSplit" targetRef="Task_SkillEnhancement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_DevSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SkillEnhancement" targetRef="Gateway_DevJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_DevJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_DevJoin" targetRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesReached" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${milestonesReached == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_HRReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_HRReview" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a decision after a review is approved or not approved, and that the approved outcome is followed by a named action performed on the item before the process moves on to a later stage: Model the decision as an exclusive gateway with one conditional outgoing flow per outcome. On the approved flow, place a task that names the approved action, and connect that task to the next stage, so the approved path does not skip the action. On the not-approved flow, return to the earlier stage named in the description. Do not connect the decision gateway directly to the later stage, and do not omit the approval action task.
rules.situation: the description states that a decision after a review is approved or not approved, and that the approved outcome is followed by a named action performed on the item before the process moves on to a later stage

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant keeps performing an activity while another participant provides feedback, evaluation, or support, or that two or more activities are joined by 'while' or 'and' and are stated to happen together rather than in order: Model the concurrent activities as separate parallel branches that start at a parallel gateway, so they can run at the same time. Close the branches with a parallel gateway that waits for all of them before the next step. Do not sequence the concurrent activities one after another, and do not route them through an exclusive gateway, because an exclusive gateway chooses one path while the description requires both to proceed.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant keeps performing an activity while another participant provides feedback, evaluation, or support, or that two or more activities are joined by 'while' or 'and' and are stated to happen together rather than in order

rules.instruction: When the description ends a choice with alternative outcomes, where each outcome is a named action performed on the item (for example approving it or discarding it), and the generated model connects that outcome branch directly to an end event: Model each named outcome action as its own task on its branch, placed after the choice gateway and before the end event that closes the process. The end event follows the task and does not replace it. Do not use the end event label to carry the action.
rules.situation: the description states that a process ends only after a decision outcome is followed by one or more named actions performed in order (such as finalizing the outcome and then transitioning into a new state), and the generated model would close the process with an end event whose label names that outcome or action

rules.instruction: When the description states that, after an approval outcome, several distinct actions follow in sequence (for example a change in pay, a change in duties, and a move into a new role), and then says the process ends once the last of them is done: Model each listed action after the approval outcome as its own task, in the order the description states, on the approved path. Do not merge them into one task whose label lists all the actions, and do not fold the last action into the end event label. Place the end event after the final action task, and label it with the outcome it represents.
rules.situation: the description states that, after an approval outcome, several distinct actions follow in sequence (for example a change in pay, a change in duties, and a move into a new role), and then says the process ends once the last of them is done
